g.text: Frozen DINOv3-B / Causal task-attention intent / Latent KD / Inference-only tail reuse
A Teacher stage: action-shaped privileged latent
Train posterior + action network; freeze DINO
xτ = (1−τ) ε + τ a | τ, s(t)
B Student stage: compatible initialization + latent KD
Current multi-layer features → student visual adapter
xτ = (1−τ) ε + τ a | τ, s(t)
KD: predictor only; action loss: whole student path
C Online inference: causal intent + unexecuted action-tail feedback
No teacher, future input, KD or backpropagation
Current multi-layer vision bypasses intent pooling
No direct VTT token; no gate
First chunk: standard Gaussian noise only
Re-observe and replan after every 4 actions
Scope: Meta-World MT50 / corner2; C8 / E4 / H8. Gaussian FM training; tail feedback at inference only. Patch/token glyphs are schematic.
